observations.description: Traffic is blocked when an AV profiled is enabled in proxy inspection mode in an IPsec scenario with NPU offloading enabled.
FQDN address and FQDN custom service do not work as expected in security policy.
WAD crash at signal 11.
Proxy inspection fails due to ipsappsessionopenfailed:allprovidersbusy.
dhcpd is not processing discover messages if they contain a 0 length option, such as 80 (rapid commit). The warning, length0overflowsinputbuffer, is displayed.
When IPS and AV are enabled in flow mode, traffic cannot be redirected to NTurbo in interface-based IPsec scenario.
The new HA primary FortiGate cannot get EMS Cloud information when HA switches over.
observations.workaround: delete the EMS Cloud entry then add it back.

observations.description: Within the Policy & Objects menu, the firewall, DoS, and traffic shaping policy pages take around five seconds to load when the FortiGate cannot reach the FortiGuard DNS servers.
observations.workaround: set the DNS server to the FortiGuard DNS server.

observations.description: On the System > FortiGuard page, the override FortiGuard server for AntiVirus & IPS Updates shows an Unknown status, even if the server is working correctly. This is a display issue only; the override feature is working properly.

On the Network > Interfaces page when VDOM mode is enabled, the Global view incorrectly shows the status of IPsec tunnel interfaces from non-management VDOMs as up. The VDOM view shows the correct status.
On the Policy & Objects > Firewall Policy page, the policy list can take around 30 seconds or more to load when there is a large number (over 20 thousand) of policies.
observations.workaround: use the CLI to configure policies.

observations.description: System > Certificates list sometimes shows an incorrect reference count for a certificate, and incorrectly allows a user to delete a referenced certificate. The deletion will fail even though a success message is shown. Users should be able to delete the certificate after all references are removed.
When using the SSL VPN web portal in the Firefox, users cannot paste text into the SSH terminal emulator.
observations.workaround: use Chrome, Edge, or Safari as the browser.

observations.description: When a FortiGate is managed by FortiManager with FortiWLM configured, the HTTPS daemon may crash while processing some FortiWLM API requests. There is no apparent impact on the GUI operation.
When upgrade firmware from 7.0.1 to 7.0.2, the GUI incorrectly displays a warning saying this is not a valid upgrade path.

Managed FortiSwitches page incorrectly shows a warning about an unregistered FortiSwitch even though it is registered. This only impacts transferred or RMAed FortiSwitches. This is only a display issue with no impact on the FortiSwitch's operation.
observations.workaround: confirm the FortiSwitch registration status in the FortiCare portal.

observations.description: When logged in as guest management administrator, the custom image shows as empty on the user information printout.
observations.workaround: use the regular Guest Management page.

observations.description: When private data encryption is enabled, all passwords present in the configuration fail to load and may cause HA failures.
After shutting down the HA primary unit and then restarting it, the uptime for both nodes is zero, and it fails back to the former primary unit.
A few tasks are hung on issuing statverbose on the secondary device.
IPS engine 7.00105 has signal14(Alarmclock) crash during stress testing.
IPsec aggregate static route is not marked inactive if the IPsec aggregate is down.
Traffic that goes through IPsec based on a loopback interface cannot be offloaded.
When net-device is enabled on the hub, the tunnel interface IP is missing in the routing table.
IPsec static router gateway IP is set to the gateway of the tunnel interface when it is not specified.
NP dropping packet in the incoming direction for SoC4 models.
When submitting files for sandbox logging in flow mode, filetype="unknown" is displayed for PDF, DOC, JS, RTF, ZIP, and RAR files.
An error case occurs in WAD while handling the HTTP requests for an explicit proxy policy.
Video filter FortiGuard category takes precedence over allowed channel ID exception in the same category.

FortiGate goes into conserve mode due to high memory usage of WAD user-info process. The WAD user-info process will query the user count information from the LDAP server every 24 hours. If any of the LDAP query messages are closed by exceptions, there is a memory leak. If obtain-user-info is enabled under configuserldap, this memory leak will be triggered on daily basis.
observations.workaround: create an automation stitch to restart the WAD daemon every day to avoid conserve mode.

observations.description: The default SD-WAN route for the LTE wwan interface is not created.
observations.workaround: add a random gateway to the wwan member. configsystemsdwan configmembers edit2 setinterface"wwan" setgateway10.198.58.58 setpriority100 next end end

observations.description: Slow GUI performance in large Fabric topology with over 50 downstream devices.
Security rating Optimization card shows failure for system uptime due to low uptime for FortiAP (less than 24 hours).

Fabric Management page incorrectly shows some FortiAPs with an unregistered FortiCare status even though the FortiAP is already registered. This is just a display issue and does not impact FortiAP operation.
Security Rating report for Rogue AP Detection and FortiCare Support checks show incorrect results.
SNAT is not working in SSL VPN web mode when accessing an SFTP server.
User peer feature for one group to match to multiple user peers in the authentication rules is broken.
A large number of detected devices causes httpsd to consume resources, and causes entry-level devices to enter conserve mode.
TCP 8008 permitted by authd, even though the service in the policy does not include that port.
A DNS proxy crash occurs during ssl_ctx_free.
Traffic passing through an EMAC VLAN interface when the parent interface is in another VDOM is blocked if NP7 offloading is enabled.
observations.workaround: set the auto-asic-offload option to disable in the firewall policy.

observations.description: Random LTE modem disconnections due to certain carriers getting unstable due to WWAN modem USB speed under super-speed.
The value of the extra-init parameter under configsystemlte-modem is not passed to the modem after rebooting the device.
High CPU usage on platforms with low free memory upon IPS engine initialization.
On FG-100F, no event is raised for PSU failure and the diagnostic command is not available.
On a FortiGate with many FortiSwitches and FortiAPs, the Device Inventory widget and user-device-storelist are empty.
After upgrading from 6.4.9 to 7.0.5, the FG-110xE's 1000M SFP interface may fail to auto-negotiate and cannot be up due to the missed auto-negotiation.
High memory usage occurs on FG-200F.
When setting the speed of 1G SFP ports on FG-180xF platforms to 1000full, the interface does not come up after rebooting.
Can'tfindxitem.Droptheresponse. error appears for DHCPOFFER packets in the DHCP relay debug.
The kernel 4.19 cannot concurrently reassemble IPv4 fragments for a source IP with more than 64 destination IP addresses.
After updating the FSSO DC agent to version 5.0.0301, the DC agent keeps crashing on Windows 2012 R2 and 2016, which causes lsass.exe to reboot.
SCEP fails to renew if the local certificate name length is between 31 and 35 characters.
FG-ARM64-AWS kernel panic occurs (Kernelpanic-notsyncing:Fatalexceptionin interrupt).
Block replacement page is not pushed automatically to replace the video content when using a video filter.
